title: Rough Shifting
summary: Lightweight diagnostic path for harsh shifts, delayed engagement, fluid concerns, and estimate continuity.
intro: Rough shifting should be treated as a fluid, control, sensor, and mechanical question before a major transmission repair is assumed.
common_sounds: Delayed engagement into drive or reverse
quick_checks: Check fluid level, condition, smell, and leak evidence where serviceable
Scan transmission codes and freeze-frame data
Check battery and charging voltage if electronic shifting acts erratically
Road test to capture gear, temperature, and throttle conditions

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Fluid and Leak Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: Fluid level and condition can change shift quality and should be documented before bigger estimates.
checks: Inspect fluid condition and leak points
Check service history before recommending fluid service

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Control and Code Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: Electronic shift concerns need code, voltage, and sensor context before parts are priced.
checks: Record gear, speed, and temperature during the harsh shift

recommended_repairs.title: Transmission Diagnostic
recommended_repairs.description: Use before quoting repairs when fluid, codes, or controls have not been verified.

recommended_repairs.title: Shift Concern Diagnosis
recommended_repairs.description: Use when the complaint is repeatable during road test.
